settings.installText: Install Journey Studio as a real PWA. This creates the application identity used by Windows and the browser. Do not use downloaded Internet Shortcut (.url/.download) files as the app shortcut.
settings.installInstalledText: The app is running with the installed PWA identity.
settings.installUnavailable: The browser install prompt is not currently available. Open Journey Studio in Edge or Chrome and use the browser Install app command.
settings.installNote: Desktop/Start-menu shortcuts are created by the browser during PWA installation. Journey Studio does not download a Windows Internet Shortcut. If you want a real desktop shortcut later, open Windows Apps with Win+R → shell:AppsFolder and drag Journey Studio to the desktop.
settings.shortcutText: Journey Studio cannot silently write a Windows .lnk file from the web sandbox. This button opens the correct Edge app manager so Windows creates the real installed-app shortcut instead of an Internet Shortcut.
settings.shortcutStep1: Open Edge Apps using the button below.
settings.shortcutStep2: Find Journey Studio and open Details.
settings.shortcutWhyText: It produces a real Windows shortcut tied to the installed PWA, with the Journey Studio app identity and icon.
